Dear Joi and Mizuka,
Warm greetings from Tokyo!
I thought you might like to hear a little bit about the tea gathering experience, so I wanted to share.
It has been an interesting experience. Amazing, how one event can combine together so many cultural pieces.

EFTA00565565

 The tea master...like you said earlier Joi, she is wonderful! So warm and graceful. She said she had started
making tea since she was in her 51h grade, and has been doing it every day ever since. She must be a legend!
When I passed your regards to her, she looked very happy!
And what a beautiful place! Being located in the middle of busy Tokyo streets, yet it felt so serene...

Again, Joi thank you for connecting me with Toki! They have arranged many wonderful experiences. It has
been a great time and I am very much enjoying learning about Japan.

Best wishes,
Karyna.
